summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an ordinary current report) disclosing its November 6, 2026 joint press release with AMTD Digital Inc. and The Generation Essentials Group (TGE). Under an Asset Transfer and Share Issuance Agreement dated October 21, 2026, TGE acquired four premium hotel assets from AMTD Digital — the Tribeca Hotel, a 50% equity interest with veto rights in the Ritz-Carlton Perth, the Dao By Dorsett Hornsey London and 80% of Upper Regalia Kuala Lumpur — for an aggregate purchase price of US$209,766,000, inclusive of underlying debts. Consideration was satisfied in full on November 2, 2026 by issuance of 198,630,381 new TGE Class A ordinary shares to AMTD Digital, priced off the 30-trading-day NYSE VWAP ending May 29, 2026. The transfer followed AMTD IDEA's prior contribution of the Target Assets into AMTD Digital via settlement of US$209,766,000 of intercompany indebtedness. Post-transaction, AMTD Digital holds 88.2% of TGE (91.1% voting power) and AMTD IDEA beneficially owns 95.6%. The structure is a related-party asset injection consolidating hospitality assets under TGE; watch TGE share-issuance dilution, related-party valuation scrutiny and any minority-holder objections to the VWAP-based pricing.
